from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689794/attempts/a536beb1a07649f1b9f85ee1d72dd80c/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Locate a full, uniform divider row or column.
    div_row = next((r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1), None)
    div_col = next((c for c in range(w) if all(row[c] == grid[0][c] for row in grid)), None)
    if div_row is not None:
        a, b = grid[:div_row], grid[div_row + 1:]
        if not a or not b:
            raise ValueError("divider must separate two panels")
        palette_a = set(v for row in a for v in row)
        palette_b = set(v for row in b for v in row)
        common = palette_a & palette_b
        base = next(iter(common)) if len(common) == 1 else min(common)
        return [[3 if a[r][c] == base and b[r][c] == base else base
                 for c in range(w)] for r in range(len(a))]
    if div_col is not None:
        a = [row[:div_col] for row in grid]
        b = [row[div_col + 1:] for row in grid]
        if not a[0] or not b[0]:
            raise ValueError("divider must separate two panels")
        palette_a = set(v for row in a for v in row)
        palette_b = set(v for row in b for v in row)
        common = palette_a & palette_b
        base = next(iter(common)) if len(common) == 1 else min(common)
        return [[3 if a[r][c] == base and b[r][c] == base else base
                 for c in range(len(a[0]))] for r in range(h)]
    raise ValueError("no full divider found")
'''
path=programs/'task-24bd8a68.py'; path.write_text(code)
print(path)
